identity.title: [v0.92][ADR] Author and review the milestone architecture decision record set

review_prompts: Does every candidate decision follow from cited landed repository evidence rather than forward-looking plans?
Do authority, TLS, replay, mutation, identity, and witness decisions retain fail-closed boundaries and precise non-claims?
Are ADR 0069 and ADR 0071 deferred unless their real WP-18A and WP-18B proof is landed?
Does ADR 0070 remain planning-only without implying production cross-polis transfer?
Are numbering, status, supersession, approval, and index relationships complete and collision-free?
residual_risk: All thirteen records remain Proposed or Deferred; architecture acceptance requires separate human governance action.
Operational cross-polis continuity, Observatory runtime consumption, and provider-neutral multi-agent proof remain explicitly unproven and deferred.
